services.noFindings: Nothing wrong with this service's routing.
routecheck.hint503NoUpstream: 503 from the sidecar with no upstream: no cluster for this host and port — check that the Service exposes the port and the VirtualService destination matches.
routecheck.hint503NoHealthy: 503 from the sidecar: the Service has no healthy endpoints — check the pods and readiness probes.
editor.focusNotFound: Could not find {path} in the YAML
hint.vs-host-missing: Create the Service, or fix the destination host (short names resolve in the VirtualService's namespace).
hint.vs-subset-undefined: Add the subset to a DestinationRule for this host, or remove it from the route.
hint.vs-port-not-exposed: Use one of the Service's ports, or drop the port on a single-port Service.
hint.vs-gateway-missing: Create the Gateway, or reference it as namespace/name.
hint.vs-host-conflict: Merge the rules into one VirtualService, or give each a distinct host; Istio applies only one in an undefined order.
hint.backend-no-endpoints: Check the backend's pods and readiness probes; nothing is ready to receive traffic.
hint.httproute-backend-missing: Create the Service, or fix the backendRef name/namespace.
hint.httproute-port-not-exposed: Use one of the Service's ports in the backendRef.
hint.httproute-not-accepted: Check the Gateway's listeners and the route's parentRef (hostname, port, namespace policy).
hint.gateway-not-programmed: Check the GatewayClass controller and the listener configuration.
hint.dr-host-missing: Create the Service, or fix the DestinationRule host.
hint.dr-subset-no-pods: Label the pods to match the subset, or fix the subset labels.
hint.gateway-selector-no-pods: Deploy the gateway workload, or fix the selector to match its pods.
hint.namespace-injection-no-sidecar: Restart the listed pods so the sidecar is injected, or opt them out with sidecar.istio.io/inject: "false".
